mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. The moon phase is a waxing crescent, and we have an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain predicted. The ISS passes overhead at 6:31 PM, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has posted various notices for the upcoming general elections in November. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, for their December 7 meeting.
There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 tonight. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia happens tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmer's Market is this Saturday.
On October 22, a vehicle crash occurred between a car and a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for failure to yield the right of way.
Culver's is serving up Devil's Food Cake as today's flavor. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
